November 5, 2026


CNA West is back, and Cameco is excited to once again be exploring the opportunities ahead for nuclear energy in Western Canada! We’re kicking things off at the trade show and opening reception today, with plenty more to come over the next three days. If you're attending this year's event, stop by the Cameco booth, say hello to our team and chat with us about our operations, careers and opportunities at Cameco. Looking forward to a great few days in Calgary! #CNAWEST2026[#NuclearEnergy](https://facebook.com/hashtag/NuclearEnergy) #Calgary
